context: A doctor explains a science topic to a curious young child
purpose: Teach: イカ/羊/獣/海洋/周波数/計量/結合/生み出す

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生、水族館でイカを見たよ！イカって魚なの？
lines.en: Doctor, I saw squid at the aquarium! Are squid fish?
lines.style: Excited child sharing recent experience with curiosity

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いい質問だね。実はイカは魚じゃないんだ。海洋の生き物の中でも、とても変わった仲間なんだよ。
lines.en: Great question. Actually squid aren't fish. They're a very unusual kind of marine creature.
lines.style: Warm doctor explaining gently at child's level

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ！じゃあ草原を走る羊とは全然ちがう生き物なんだね。
lines.en: Wow! So they're totally different creatures from sheep running in fields.
lines.style: Surprised child drawing a simple animal comparison

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: その通り。陸の獣と海の生き物では、体のつくりがまったく違うんだ。
lines.en: Exactly. Land beasts and sea creatures have completely different bodies.
lines.style: Encouraging doctor affirming the child's insight clearly

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえ先生、イルカはお話できるって本当？
lines.en: Hey Doctor, is it true dolphins can talk?
lines.style: Eager child shifting topics with bright energy

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当だよ。イルカは高い周波数の音を出して、仲間とおしゃべりするんだ。研究所ではその音を計量する機械もあるんだよ。
lines.en: It's true. Dolphins make high-frequency sounds to chat with friends. The lab even has machines to measure those sounds.
lines.style: Detailed but child-friendly scientific explanation with patience

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: みんなで音を合わせたら、もっとすごい音が結合して生まれるのかな？
lines.en: If they combine sounds together, could even more amazing sounds be born?
lines.style: Imaginative child wondering aloud with sparkling curiosity

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 面白い発想だね。実際、いろんな音が結合して、新しい意味を生み出すこともあるんだよ。
lines.en: What an interesting idea. In fact, sounds can combine to create new meanings sometimes.
lines.style: Patient doctor validating and building on child's imagination

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも大きくなったら海の科学者になりたい！
lines.en: When I grow up, I want to be an ocean scientist too!
lines.style: Bright determined child declaring his future dream
